Name: Joja Prize Machine and Ticket Recolor
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
It was only a matter of time before Joja found another perfectly innocent town feature to “improve.”

Gives the prize machine, prize machine menu interface, and prize ticket item a Joja themed visual makeover.

The main file is configurable and works on any route by default. To make it Joja Members Only, set JojaMemberRequired to true in config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.

Requirement:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[b]This mod only affects:[/b]
-Prize Machine in the Mayor's house
-Prize Machine interface
-Prize Ticket item
-It does not change any mechanics, rewards, or gameplay.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
-Compatible with recolor mods and set to load after them, so the Joja assets should take priority.
-Only affects the Prize Machine, Prize Machine interface, and Prize Ticket assets.
-If you use an interior recolor, the small wallpaper area behind the Prize Machine’s animated light bulb may not perfectly match. The rest of the machine should look fine.


[b]Want more Joja nonsense? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/LeelooStardew/mods]my profile[/url] for more Joja-themed mods![/b]
